title: 建築CAD
subtitle: Architectural CAD
keywords: Architectural design 2.Building Information Modeling 3.Lighting Simulation 4.Cooperation between design and production 5.Regional collaboration
educationalGoal: In architectural design, it is important to visualize ideas with 3D models and drawings using digital media and to communicate smoothly with others using the data. In this course, students will learn about architectural expression with BIM software, which has been spreading in recent years as the basis of digital architectural representation. Specifically, students will learn about creating 3D models and drawing of the building designed by themselves, lighting simulation, utilizing attribute information, and making presentations.
advice: In this course, exercise lessons will be conducted using BIM software in the CAD room as follows. #1st week; Explanation of the purpose and outline of the course, introduction of BIM software #2-6th week; How to make 3D model of residential building using BIM software #7-9th week; How to make drawings of residential building using BIM software #10-13th week; How to make presentation board of residential building using BIM software #14th week; Application of BIM software with smart device #15th week; Lesson for looking back and self-check
books: Archicad Magic(PDF reference book downloadable from manufacturer's website)
requiredKnowledge: # Students must tackle assignments with residential building designed by themselves in "Architectural Design Studio I" in the last semester. # Students shouldn't be absent because the exercises will be carried out in a stackable manner. # Students should have awareness to enhance computer utilization skills such as software installation, data management, and printer settings.

activityGoals.body: Students can create 3D model of a design proposal appropriately using BIM software.
Students can create drawings of a design proposal appropriately using BIM software.
Students can simulate Lighting environment of a design proposal appropriately using BIM software.
Students can survey basic quantities of a design proposals using attribute data of BIM software.
Students can create presentation board of a design proposal using BIM software.
